**Risk flags:**
- Defendant in 1 case(s), total claims RM55,200  
- Single shareholder holds 63.4%

**Overview:**  
Mutiara Seri Runcit Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited retail company operating a convenience store for daily necessities in Kuala Lumpur. It was incorporated on 2005-12-11 and currently has three directors. The company’s share capital is RM100,000, with the largest shareholder owning 63.4% of the equity. Reported revenues are RM30.2 million, RM31.2 million and RM33.0 million in the most recent three periods, with equity rising from RM17.4 million to RM18.1 million and RM18.7 million respectively. No audit opinion or net profit figures are provided.
